properties.markdown:
## Nexus
Filtros (regex): **Cluster** (`Todos` = sin filtro) · **Servicio** sin `/ESBService/` (ej `ConsultaBolsillos`, varios `A|B`, `.*` = todos) · **Canal** (ej `37`, varios `37|01`, `.*` = todos; no aplica a API Gateway, ERROR LOGS ni RESUMEN ERRORES) · **Rquid** solo para la fila 4.
SOAP responde HTTP 200 aunque falle: el error real está en la fila 1. Infra ECS y el gráfico de 504 por minuto no tienen filtros (métricas globales).

properties.query:
SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/accountsws-iseries-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/accountsws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/acquiringws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/clientsws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cardsws-iseries-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cardsws-postilion-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cardsws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/insurancesws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/investmentsws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/loansws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/paymentsws-iseries-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/paymentsws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/productsws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/remittancesws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/securityws-stratus-adapter" |
filter @log like /\/(CLUSTER_VAR)-(stratus|iseries|postilion)-adapter$/ and @message like /(SERVICE_VAR)/
| fields @message, @log
| parse @message /X-Name=(?<canalA>[^,\]]+)/
| parse @message /\[[0-9a-f-]{36}\]\[(?<canalB>[^\]]*)\]/
| fields coalesce(canalA, canalB, "") as canal
| filter canal like /^(CANAL_VAR)$/
| filter @message like /GenericExceptionMapper/ and @message like /HttpCode::/
| parse @message /HttpCode::\s*(?<httpCode>\d+)/
| filter httpCode = "400"
| parse @message /Exception:\s*\d+\s*::[^.]*\.(?<direccion>[A-Za-z]+):\s*(?<plantilla>.*?)\. 1=(?<params>.*?)\s*::HEAD::/
| parse @message /Exception:\s*\d+\s*::\s*(?<mensaje>[^.]*[^.\s])/
| parse @message /\.For input string:\s*"(?<entrada>[^"]*)"/
| parse params /^(?<p1>.*?)(?:, 2=|$)/
| parse params /, 2=(?<p2>.*?)(?:, 3=|$)/
| parse params /, 3=(?<p3>.*)$/
| parse plantilla /(?<usaP3>para: %3)/
| parse @log /\/aws\/ecs\/srv\/(?<adaptador>\S+)$/
| parse @message /X-Referer=[^-,]+-[^-,]+-[^-,]+-(?<servicio>[^-,\]]+)/
| fields if(isPresent(usaP3), p3, p1) as campo, substr(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(p1, "0", "9"), "1", "9"), "2", "9"), "3", "9"), "4", "9"), "5", "9"), "6", "9"), "7", "9"), "8", "9"), 0, 20) as p1Forma, substr(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(entrada, "0", "9"), "1", "9"), "2", "9"), "3", "9"), "4", "9"), "5", "9"), "6", "9"), "7", "9"), "8", "9"), 0, 20) as entradaForma,
    coalesce(plantilla, mensaje) as regla
| fields if(isPresent(plantilla), replace(replace(replace(plantilla, "%1", coalesce(p1Forma, "%1")), "%2", coalesce(p2, "%2")), "%3", coalesce(p3, "%3")), concat("For input string: ", coalesce(entradaForma, "?"))) as detalle
| stats count(*) as total, latest(detalle) as ejemplo by direccion, regla, campo, adaptador, servicio, canal
| sort total desc
| limit 1000

SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/accountsws-iseries-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/accountsws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/acquiringws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/clientsws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cardsws-iseries-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cardsws-postilion-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cardsws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/insurancesws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/investmentsws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/loansws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/paymentsws-iseries-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/paymentsws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/productsws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/remittancesws-stratus-adapter" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/securityws-stratus-adapter" |
filter @message like "RQUID_VAR"
| fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log
|filter @message like "AUDIT" 
|parse @message /RqUid=(?<rq_uid>[A-Za-z0-9-]+)[^A-Za-z0-9-]/
|parse @message /requestUid=(?<rq_uid1>[A-Za-z0-9-]+)[^A-Za-z0-9-]/
|parse @message /X-FnctName=(?<fnctName>[A-Za-z0-9-]+)[^A-Za-z0-9-]/
|parse @message /X-Name=(?<Name>[A-Za-z0-9-]+)[^A-Za-z0-9-]/
|parse @message "::AUDIT::*::" as TipoOperacion
|parse @message "::AUDIT::*" as mensaje
|parse @log /\/aws\/ecs\/srv\/(?<adaptador>\S+)$/
|display  @timestamp , coalesce(rq_uid , rq_uid1) as Rquid , fnctName , Name , TipoOperacion , adaptador, mensaje
|filter Rquid like "RQUID_VAR"
| sort Rquid desc
| limit 1000
